description: Upcoming EARNINGS DATES for one issuer, provenance-labelled: published_events are dates the ISSUER posted on its own IR calendar; estimate is an Oxford Ledge projection from the issuer's SEC filing cadence, with its confidence. Returns {ticker, published_events, published_events_degraded, estimate, provenance_rule, note}. The two are NOT merged: prefer a published date yourself, and never present the estimate as a company announcement. SCOPE: US domestic 8-K filers only. Read published_events_degraded before reading the note as an issuer fact. Distinct from get_economic_calendar (macro releases). Source: issuer IR pages + SEC filing cadence (Oxford Ledge); FREE. Caveats ride the response's tool_notes.
name: ol_earnings_calendar
